therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Tryptophan hydroxylase inhibition to reduce serotonin synthesis
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Prevention of serotonin-mediated weight loss and muscle wasting
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with advanced stage pancreatic cancer

results.target_engagement_evidence: Reduced blood serotonin levels from 170.92 ng/mL to 85.33 ng/mL in telotristat group vs maintained levels in control
biomarker_changes: Blood serotonin decreased in telotristat group (170.92 to 85.33 ng/mL)
24-hr urine 5-HIAA levels increased in telotristat group (3 to 9 mg) vs decreased in control (4 to 1 mg)
results.dose_information: Given PO (oral administration), specific dose not provided

context.duration: Up to 2 years follow-up, primary endpoint at 3 months
